name: P-N Method (Spherical Harmonics)
aliases: Spherical Harmonics Expansion for Scattering Equation
definition: A method to solve the multiple scattering integral equation by expanding I(X, ω) in spherical harmonics in the unit sphere direction ω, resulting in a coupled system of partial differential equations for the coefficients.
summary: The P-N method solves multiple scattering by expanding directional intensity into spherical harmonics, yielding a smooth angular representation equivalent to optimally placed discrete ordinates.
